The records predate per-record store fields (9cc0121c86d): store identified post hoc by its pinned release. Assumption op_write_bytes[deletes] backs ebs/deletes/mutation_deletes: ASSUMPTION, the largest measured record per dropped part (273 kB fit, 125 kB hold-out: the per-part unit did not carry). registry.label: Async flush: an INSERT with data of at most async_insert_max_data_size bytes is queued (INSERT SELECT and larger data run synchronously); inserts with the same user, roles, query shape, settings and data kind share a buffer; it is flushed into one part per partition when its unparsed bytes reach async_insert_max_data_size, when async_insert_max_query_number inserts accumulate with deduplication on, or when its deadline passes.
